voices.name: Chipper
voices.blurb: Small, fast and far too pleased with itself.

voices.name: Deep Six
voices.blurb: Something enormous, speaking from the bottom of a well.

voices.name: Whisperkill
voices.blurb: A gravelly stranger on a bad phone line. Do not answer.

voices.name: Ascend
voices.blurb: Your own voice, lifted. Formants held, so it reads as a different person.

voices.name: Descend
voices.blurb: Your own voice, lowered. Formants held, so it reads as a different person.

voices.name: Tinhead
voices.blurb: Clipped, metallic and entirely without warmth.

voices.name: Toaster
voices.blurb: Harsher machine flutter, one bad solder joint from failing.

voices.name: Handset
voices.blurb: Squeezed through a cheap radio, static and all.
